target.statement: PixelCraft with GPT-4.1-mini achieves 68.1% accuracy on the CharXiv reasoning benchmark, compared to 63.8% for CoT.

compute.basis: The target requires a multi-agent system with a fine-tuned grounding model (Qwen2.5-VL-3B) trained on 53k samples using 4 A100 GPUs, plus extensive API calls to GPT-4.1-mini for multiple agents, making it infeasible on a CPU-only laptop within hours.

blockers: No code or data released (paper states 'Our code will be available' but no actual release).
Requires fine-tuning a 3B MLLM on 53k samples using 4 A100 GPUs.
Requires extensive API calls to GPT-4.1-mini for multiple agents (dispatcher, planner, reasoner, critics).
Evaluation involves running the full multi-agent pipeline on the CharXiv benchmark, which is computationally heavy and time-consuming.
title: PixelCraft: A Multi-Agent System for High-Fidelity Visual Reasoning on Structured Images
